tasks.summary: Fix end-of-battle audio stinger reliability and prevent repeated triggers.
Add impact profile kit (hit-stop, decals, scaled shakes) to damage handling for players and enemies.
Add punchy enemy death feedback (flash + smoke VFX, shake, optional death sounds) with double-trigger guard.
Reserve start tiles for special battle openings and prefer requested tile types during placement.
Retune enemy roster for v0.0.6.1 with gentler early threats, slower obelisk spawns, and toned-down elite/void defenses and payouts.
Refresh run and battle tutorial copy to teach obelisk objective, tile effects, and currencies for v0.0.6.1.
Boss health meter deferred until the boss redesign lands to avoid rework.
Add a reusable card cost selection popup with selectable card grid, hover details, and Events hooks for rituals/events.
Introduce Bulwark and Void Channeler enemies with unique actions and expand tier 1/2 battle pools to feature them.
Overhauled enemy intent display with consistent formatting, tooltips, and palette-based visual polish.
Make enemy AI pick attacks/blocks based on player distance, block, and kill potential instead of flat weights.
Add pulsing tile highlights with pooled sprites and a scan SFX when aiming cards so valid targets are clearly marked without wiping telegraphs.
Shortened discard/draw tweens and reshuffle trails so end-of-turn hand cleanup feels snappier.
Added a quick battle intro vignette/audio dip beat that plays as combat loads without delaying turn 1.
Seeded map event nodes and built a lightweight event room with gold/resource/HP tradeoffs.
Synced battle intro/outro presentation with vignette fades and audio swells around start/end of combat.
Added a map bounty board overlay that lists gold/resource rewards for currently reachable battles.
